top_findings.title: All tests hardcode ephemeral absolute data paths instead of ./data/kaggle
top_findings.evidence: internal/store/store_test.go:9 and internal/server/server_test.go:11 pass /Users/adriancockcroft/.retort/work/retort-local-0xabe5kx/retort-*/data/kaggle to store.LoadData (32 occurrences); the archive ships data at ./data/kaggle. On any other machine or after work-dir cleanup, LoadData errors and t.Fatalf fails every test — R12 verification only holds on the original run's temp dir.
top_findings.suggestion: Load from a relative path (e.g. filepath.Join("..","..","data","kaggle")) or a testdata dir shipped with the code so tests are reproducible.
